## How is "mieux" the correct answer here??? I am so confused...

Son copain est bien mais le mien est \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.Her boyfriend is nice but mine is better. mieux meilleur plus bien pire

the above info doesnt really explain it well for me (i dont even understand why is Debra L. mixing comparitives and superlatives here but... appreciate the help...) but i figured it out (posting this since it's public anyway...)

it is mieux because the one in front used bien, so i would need to use the comparative of bien here. i got confused because le mien est meilleur would totally work as a sentence itself.

appreciate Céline for offering me the link (i think i missed this "When **_mieux_**, the comparative of _bien_, is an adjective, it’s used with copular (state-of-being) verbs and means "better" along the lines of sense of more moral, satisfying, healthy, or attractive.") i would appreciate a direct answer because i was already too frustrated, but appreciate a lot for posting the exact info i needed! took me too long to figure out whats going on...would refine my question next time i post, i was way too frustrated.

please correct me if i got anything wrong. appreciate it!
